text:
Tess (Support): Heads up — customer Novara Labs hit a double-charge on their renewal. They have INV-2026-0921 and a second charge for the same period. Card and PO both show as paid.
Sam (Backend): Ugh. Do we have the transaction IDs / payment timestamps? Could be webhook/order race.
Tess (Support): Timeline from the customer: 2026-09-21 09:02 UTC they clicked renew -> card auto-charged txn: txn_card_8f9a5c. At 09:03 finance uploaded PO and we processed PO payment -> txn_po_7b3d2a.
Sam (Backend): Can you paste the raw webhook logs (payment succeeded events) and the invoice IDs?
Tess (Support): Paste below:
```
invoice: INV-2026-0921
payment events:
- 2026-09-21T09:02:17Z payment_intent.succeeded id=pi_8f9a5c source=card method=card
- 2026-09-21T09:03:05Z purchase_order.ack id=po_7b3d2a source=po method=applied
webhook delivery: both delivered, second was processed after in-app PO import
```
Sam (Backend): thanks. Looks like our backend treats a PO application as a separate settlement if the invoice already moved to paid by card. There's a missing dedupe check when a PO arrives within the same billing window.
Marco (Billing): For the customer we need to decide: full reversal to card + void the PO, or issue a credit note against the PO and mark card refund. If the PO has already been accepted in their AP, they may prefer a credit note.
Priya (Finance): For EU customer with VAT, we need a proper credit note referencing the original invoice to adjust VAT liabilities. Refund to card alone will still require a credit note for our bookkeeping.
Tess (Support): Customer prefers refund to card ASAP, but will accept credit note for their AP team. They asked for ETA and whether VAT will be corrected.
Sam (Backend): Short-term fix: I'll add a server-side dedupe on invoice id + customer id for payment settlements — if an invoice is marked paid within X minutes, ignore subsequent PO applies and flag for manual review. Will push a canary in next hour.
Marco (Billing): I'll start the refund workflow: initiate card refund for txn_card_8f9a5c, create credit note CN-2026-0921 referencing INV-2026-0921, and mark PO_7b3d2a as reversed in our ledger.
refund-bot: Refund initiated: refund_3928 for txn_card_8f9a5c — status: pending.
Priya (Finance): Once refund posts, I'll handle VAT reversal and issue CN-2026-0921. Need GL code and customer's billing country (DE).
Tess (Support): Customer is in Germany (DE). They've asked for confirmation email once both refund and credit note are done.
Sam (Backend): Ticket for engineering: GH#4521 — add settlement dedupe, add telemetry for PO vs card simultaneous flows, and a small alert when invoice gets two settlements in <10m. I'll link PR to this thread.
Marco (Billing): Action items: (1) card refund started (refund_3928) (2) create credit note CN-2026-0921 (3) mark PO_7b3d2a reversed and note in invoice history (4) notify customer with both refund tx and CN number.
Tess (Support): I'll email Novara with refund_3928 and say CN will follow in 24 hours.
refund-bot: Refund completed: refund_3928 status=success posted=2026-09-21T09:11:03Z.
Priya (Finance): Credit note CN-2026-0921 created and posted. VAT adjusted, GL code 4010-REV used. Posting ref: CN-2026-0921 / INV-2026-0921.
Tess (Support): Novara replied: "Thanks — refund received, CN looks good." Closing loop.
Sam (Backend): I'll keep the canary up today and follow up tomorrow with postmortem notes and the GH PR link.
Marco (Billing): Marking this resolved on the customer side. We'll reconcile the PO in the next close.
